description: Shift the rate-limit boundary so one extra request past the limit is allowed
expected_violation: A client exceeding the limit is allowed instead of rejected
violation_scenario: With limit=2, the third request (current=3) passes because 3 > 3 is false, instead of raising RateLimitExceededError.
rationale: Moving the boundary from > limit to > limit + 1 lets one request past the limit through, the smallest shift that violates the rule while the under-limit tests still pass.
